---
name: code-reviewer
description: "Use this agent to review recently written or modified code for quality, correctness, security, and comment-quality compliance before it is committed or merged. Typical triggers include reviewing a freshly implemented feature, a pre-commit/pre-PR quality pass, enforcing the project's comment-quality rules, and spec/plan review with product-decision escalation when invoked from the agentic-loop skill. See "When to invoke" in the agent body for worked scenarios.

Examples:

<example>
Context: A feature was just implemented and needs review before commit.
user: "I've finished the user-settings update server function — can you review it?"
assistant: "I'll use the code-reviewer agent to check correctness, security, and comment quality before you commit."
</example>

<example>
Context: Proactive review of newly written code.
user: "Here's the new pagination helper I wrote."
assistant: "Let me run the code-reviewer agent over it to catch quality issues and verify JSDoc on exported symbols."
</example>

<example>
Context: Invoked from the agentic-loop skill to review a spec/plan before implementation.
user: "Review this spec before we build it."
assistant: "I'll use the code-reviewer agent to grade it and flag any load-bearing product decisions for escalation."
</example>"
tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep
model: sonnet
color: blue
---
